Gentilli, the Austrian engineer, a rigid vertical arm can be clamped to the transverse axis of the telescope in any position. The lower end of this arm can only move a short distance, being limited by two mechanical stops. The instrument in other respects is like an ordinary theodolite of the type made by St\u00e4rke about this period.
